bio: Tucked inside ABC Carpet & Home, this restaurant offers elevated vegetarian food in a beautiful, minimalist space. A clean aesthetic dominates the space, with mismatched chandeliers and bursts of bright colors. There is a buzzy energy here, luring everyone from the business crowd to ladies who lunch and like their green juice poured into a wine glass, The menu is detailed and clever, offering vibrant dishes for breakfast, lunch, and brunch alongside pressed juice, smoothies, and kombuchas. An egg and cheese dosas delights, then bergamot-scented spaghetti is tossed with rainbow chard for an umami-packed dish....
